title: Among all German drivers who have recorded a lap time faster than 01:45.000
question: Among all German drivers who have recorded a lap time faster than 01:45.000 in any race, find the top 10 with the fastest personal best lap time. Return their full names and nationality.

    d."XCL_038" AS forename,
    d."XCL_039" AS surname,
    d."XCL_041" AS nationality
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN lapTimes AS lt ON lt."XCL_044" = d."XCL_034"
WHERE d."XCL_041" = 'German'

ORDER BY MIN(lt."XCL_048") ASC
LIMIT 10
